observations.fact: The accepted F2-WP-100 surface resolves and fingerprints the sole UnifiedDB path but explicitly creates, migrates, repairs and mutates nothing.
observations.consequence: F2-WP-206 may use the resolved canonical path but must not claim the resolver itself supplies persistence semantics. Any checkpoint writer must be a separately explicit namespaced integration surface inside the same canonical UnifiedDB, or reuse an already admitted writer if one exists. A second SQLite database is forbidden.

observations.fact: Generation-2 Goal lifecycle intentionally rejects ordinary public construction/rehydration of non-CANDIDATE GoalState/GoalRecord values; only the validated in-module lifecycle transition path may construct successor adopted state under the current contract.
observations.consequence: F2-WP-206 must not import or bypass a module-private construction authority merely to make restart tests green. Persisted adopted-goal payload may be integrity-verified as a replay envelope, but full typed GoalState rehydration requires an explicit admitted replay contract before it receives adopted-goal restart credit.

observations.fact: AgencyState permits public reconstruction from concrete validated Interest, OpenLoop and DeferredIntent values and evolves only under state-id/generation/digest fenced patches.
observations.consequence: AgencyState restart credit may be tested directly, but replay must reconstruct the concrete typed item ABI and re-check canonical state digest.

observations.fact: Wake/HOLD generation 3 binds explicit observation payload/provenance and fail-closes state identity, but has no clock, sensor, persistence, scheduler or auto-resume authority.
observations.consequence: Restart must preserve HOLD/UNKNOWN. Missing observations after restart may not be converted into resume. A positive WakeEvaluation remains evidence/candidate input to a higher integration policy, not an effect or scheduler command.

observations.fact: Persistent Pulse returns explicitly supplied action-class eligibility only; HOLD suppresses ACT/DELEGATE and the component neither selects nor executes actions.
observations.consequence: A deterministic next tick may prove eligibility replay but cannot be reported as autonomous action execution or effect authority.

observations.fact: StateFingerprint exposes projection_changed separately from identity_changed, with generation included only in exact state identity.
observations.consequence: WP-206 restart/next-tick tests must distinguish unchanged projection with moved lineage/generation from actual projection-content change.

required_acceptance_gates: Resolve one canonical absolute UnifiedDB path and fail closed on explicit authority conflict; do not create a second truth database.
Use a Frankenstein-2 namespaced integration table or an already-admitted canonical writer; document writer ownership separately from F2-WP-100 read-only identity authority.

Persist one canonical checkpoint envelope binding checkpoint identity, generation, exact component schemas, canonical component payload digests, provenance references, and prior/parent checkpoint identity where applicable.

Use transactional write semantics such that an existing checkpoint identity with different bytes/digest fails closed; an exact-byte idempotent replay may be explicitly classified but must not silently replace history.
Process A writes and exits; a distinct subprocess/process B opens the same resolved UnifiedDB and verifies the checkpoint without inherited in-memory objects.
AgencyState is reconstructed through its public typed ABI and its state digest must match the persisted digest.

Do not grant adopted GoalState typed rehydration credit until a public admitted replay contract exists. If generation-1 WP-206 stores adopted goal state, classify it as integrity-verified persisted goal snapshot/envelope rather than reconstructed live GoalState.
A restart with missing wake observations remains ABSTAIN/HOLD and never auto-resumes.
A positive explicit WakeEvaluation may affect only a typed integration eligibility decision; it cannot directly execute, schedule, authorize an effect or mint completion.
Next-tick Pulse output remains eligibility-only and must bind the exact checkpoint/state identity used as input.
StateFingerprint tests separately prove projection_changed and identity_changed behavior across restart and next-generation evolution.
Corrupt payload, mismatched digest, stale generation, wrong state id, wrong parent identity or provenance mismatch fail closed before producing next-tick credit.
Repository-hosted CI must execute the subprocess restart test at exact source head; source inspection alone is insufficient.
counterhypothesis: A minimal JSON/SQLite snapshot plus restart may look deterministic and survive a process boundary while still bypassing component reconstruction invariants, creating a second persistence authority, or falsely upgrading an integrity-checked goal payload into an admitted adopted GoalState. Such a test would demonstrate byte survival only, not the claimed persistent-agency integration contract.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator: Before implementation acceptance, run one hosted-CI subprocess test that writes an AgencyState plus an adopted-goal snapshot and HOLD checkpoint through the canonical resolved DB path, exits, then reopens in a fresh process. Require typed AgencyState reconstruction, verified-but-not-live adopted-goal classification unless a replay ABI is added, HOLD preservation under zero observations, exact StateFingerprint projection/lineage assertions, and corruption/stale-generation rejection.
next_exact_action: Inspect current canonical UnifiedDB writer/table ownership. If no admitted namespaced writer exists, implement the smallest F2-WP-206-owned namespaced checkpoint writer in the same resolved UnifiedDB, plus a public replay envelope that refuses to forge adopted GoalState rehydration. Add deterministic fresh-process restart/failure-path CI before reconciliation.
